scope: Read-only name discovery for blank F&B Name rows. Exact SFA licence, postal code, address and unit crosswalk required. No workbook edits.
matching_rule: Exact SFA licence in workbook plus exact six-digit postal code, street address and unit from record; corroborated outlet name from first-party operator source. No fuzzy or name-only joins.

exact_join.business_type_compatibility: Workbook SFA record is Foodcourt; operator identifies Vista Point as a Kopitiam Corner outlet.

sources.evidence: Current operator page lists Vista Point under Kopitiam Corner outlets (web source lines 119-127).
Operator document identifies 548 Woodlands (Vista Point), 548 Woodlands Drive 44 #01-21 Singapore 730548 (lines 19-22).
Search-indexed operator PDF lists Vista Point at 548 Woodlands Drive 44 #01-21 Singapore 730548. Historical corroboration only.

limitations: SFA licence plus exact address and unit uniquely identifies the workbook row, but the source address confirmation is from 2025 and 2023; current operator page corroborates Vista Point outlet presence and Kopitiam Corner brand as of observation date.
This is the named foodcourt outlet, not a name for any individual tenant stalls inside it.

exact_join.business_type_compatibility: Workbook SFA record is Foodcourt; operator identifies a Kopitiam outlet at Northpoint City B2.

sources.evidence: Current operator page lists Northpoint City B2 under Kopitiam outlets (web source lines 110-117).
Operator PDF lists Kopitiam @ Northpoint at 930 Yishun Ave 2, #B2-12 Northpoint Shopping Centre, Singapore 769098. The current official page confirms the outlet remains at Northpoint City B2.

limitations: Exact unit and postal-code evidence is from a 2022 operator PDF; current operator page corroborates Northpoint City B2 but does not display the unit or postal code.
Name identifies the foodcourt outlet; it does not name tenant stalls within it.
The current NEA public hawker-centre dataset lists centre-level fields and does not identify individual stall trading names, so it cannot safely resolve unnamed stall records by itself.

A large share of unnamed rows are individual NEA hawker stalls where centre address/postal data do not prove the stall trading name. Those were left blank rather than inferred from third-party directories or legal-entity records.
